text.p: The average yields at Tuesday's auctions of three-, six-, nine-, and 12-month treasury bills yields slipped from the last sale on February 27, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.

Three-month bills edged down to 26.10 percent from 26.83 percent, six-month bills slipped to 32.08 percent from 32.65 percent, nine-month bills edged down to 35.03 percent from 35.09 percent, and 12-month bills also slipped to 38.02 percent from 38.21 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 8.08 million UAH 7.50 million UAH
Amount sold 8.077 million UAH 7.29 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.58 million UAH 6.83 million UAH
The central bank sold 80,770 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills has not been set.
The results of Tuesday's six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 13.25 million UAH 15.00 million UAH
Amount sold 13.25 million UAH 13.86 million UAH
Actual amount raised 11.42 million UAH 11.92 million UAH
The central bank sold 132,500 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 5.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 33.76 million UAH 30.00 million UAH
Amount sold 25.57 million UAH 30.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 20.27 million UAH 23.76 million UAH
The central bank sold 255,756 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 98,721 were competitive and 157,035 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 5.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 41.87 million UAH 40.00 million UAH
Amount sold 22.48 million UAH 38.63 million UAH
Actual amount raised 16.29 million UAH 27.97 million UAH
The central bank sold 224,778 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 109,933 were competitive and 114,845 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 5.
